_comment: Creators file for Sync-Reactions.ps1. Key = the creator's folder in the library (= Download-Creator.ps1 -Creator). handling: patreon (synced), anything else is skipped. include/exclude = download categories (title or show matches; exclude wins). new_shows/movies: false to only fill gaps in shows you already have. list_file: a post URL list (collections) instead of url. Keep your real file outside this repo.
